title: File:Mont Sainte-Anne.jpg
claims: The file shows the Mont-Sainte-Anne massif in Quebec, with its ski runs visible on the mountain face.
The photograph was taken on 2012-02-05 and shows winter conditions; it is a mountain photograph, not a QMT135 race photograph.
The author is Cephas, credited under CC BY-SA 3.0; the original file is 3,840 x 2,152 pixels.
The file page requires attribution and share-alike; the route page uses a 960 x 538 Commons thumbnail and credits the author and licence.
